extraction.Name: Owen H. Valandry
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent to his 160 acre allotment at the time he got it, but that they sent him his patent in fee from Pine Ridge, and he had no choice but to take it
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to the State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1000.00; sold to Alice Wickman of Martin, South Dakota
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: in 1919, the taxes being behind, he mortgaged this allotment to the State Bank of Interior, South Dakota, for $1000.00, he could not keep up the payments on this loan, and, in 1920, he sold the allotment to Alice Wickman, telling her to clean up the taxes and mortgage, and he would give her the deed
extraction.Occupation/Income: works around town at the carpentry and mason trades, and these form the basis for his income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is pretty good; has a wife and one child to support, both of whom have good health; does not consider the price for the land was very fair but was forced to let it go under the circumstances; has never received any help from the County or Government; document dated November 19, 1928
